images.author: Lucas County (Ohio). Auditor's Office
images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: garage | Fass

facade.notes: Lucas County Auditor block card (tax-assessment photo, parcel number in frame): a detached one-car garage, gable front with board-and-batten in the gable, drop siding, a paneled overhead door with a row of lights; a chain-link fence beside it and a neighbour's garage behind: the rear-lot garage row

why.note: the rear outbuilding measured on 60-80 % of prewar lots: the car's shed at the back, on the alley or a side drive
